_readme: Starting master data, loaded ONCE when the Compliance Dashboard first runs (migration v1). After that, edit masters in the app (Master tab) or by Excel import — not here. All statutory due dates below must be verified before use.

companies.name: Saasjoy Solutions Pvt Ltd
companies.remarks: Add the Zoho Books organisation ID if this company uses Zoho Books.

compliances.name: GSTR-1 (Outward Supplies)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE. QRMP (quarterly) filers use IFF / quarterly GSTR-1 instead.

compliances.name: GSTR-3B (Summary Return)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE. QRMP filers: 22nd/24th of the month after the quarter, depending on state.

compliances.name: GST Payment
compliances.remarks: Paid with GSTR-3B. Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE.

compliances.name: ITC Reconciliation (GSTR-2B vs Books)
compliances.remarks: Internal deadline (before GSTR-3B), not a statutory date. Adjust as needed.

compliances.name: GSTR-9 (Annual Return)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE (often extended by notification). Turnover thresholds apply.

compliances.name: GSTR-9C (Reconciliation Statement)
compliances.remarks: Applies only above the turnover threshold — VERIFY applicability and due date before use.

compliances.name: PF Payment & ECR
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE.

compliances.name: ESIC Payment
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE.

compliances.name: Professional Tax (PT) Payment
compliances.remarks: STATE-SPECIFIC — VERIFY BEFORE USE. Due day and frequency differ by state (e.g. Gujarat 15th of following month, Maharashtra last day of the month, Karnataka 20th of following month).

compliances.name: Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)
compliances.remarks: STATE-SPECIFIC — VERIFY BEFORE USE. Set up as a half-yearly contribution for June and December wages (Gujarat-style). Change Applicable Months and the rule for your state.

compliances.name: TDS Payment
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE. March deductions are due 30-Apr. TDS payment and TDS return are tracked separately.

compliances.name: TDS Return — Salary (24Q)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE. Form names/numbers may change under the Income-tax Act, 2025 (effective 1-Apr-2026).

compliances.name: TDS Return — Non-Salary (26Q)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE. Form names/numbers may change under the Income-tax Act, 2025 (effective 1-Apr-2026).

compliances.name: Form 16A Issue (Non-Salary)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE (15 days after the quarterly return due date).

compliances.name: Form 16 Issue (Salary)
compliances.remarks: Statutory due date — VERIFY BEFORE USE.
